material_findings: Intrinsic restriction helps only when discarded directions are truly nuisance and tracked rank contains all task-relevant factors.
A sufficiently strong irrelevant fourth structured mode can displace a task mode and reverse fixed-k denoising benefit; target-relevant fourth signal causes sharper failure unless rank expands.
Long temporary rank collapse creates a measurable post-restoration recovery penalty; short collapse still favors intrinsic tracking.

At a fixed subspace, rank-k ambient pseudoinverse regression and intrinsic-coordinate regression are algebraically equivalent, so mechanistic comparison should target subspace estimation and rank selection rather than coordinate representation.
